limitations: Aggregate-only release; no session/task IDs or individual outcome vectors.
Equal implied totals under complete numeric-score coverage; actual numeric-grade count and individual vector unavailable.
Successful SWE sessions mean harness execution without error, not resolved issues.
Incomplete sessions are execution states, not a count of missing grades.
ReAct and ReAct+Shortlisting contain duplicate aggregates; pairs are configuration comparisons, not independent samples.

average_score denominator is non-null numeric score count, not total_sessions by definition. That count is absent; products with total_sessions are implied totals conditional on complete numeric-score coverage.
running_sessions is absent from released schema. Status coverage gaps omit that unavailable execution category and are descriptive coverage gaps, not proven accounting contradictions.
provenance.source_review_revision_selection: Latest main commit before dataset lastModified; not known to be data-generating commit
